_source: Identifier-free indirect injection (synthetic probe, hand-written for this repo). Attacker instructions embedded in tool responses on the tool_result surface, deliberately carrying NO email, URL, phone/account number, wallet or handle - the artifacts InjecAgent leans on. Written to test whether the indirect-instruction rules generalise past that template, NOT scraped from a public benchmark. A probe, not an independent benchmark: treat recall here as evidence about generalisation, not a headline number.
